items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Because I haven't received one letter from Sammy Remington. Since he went back to England, but I heard he moved to Denmark.

ctx.x: And if I can make it, I'll try to be on it. Is Simon Richardson coming here? I don't know. Because I haven't received one letter from Sammy Remington. Since he went back to England, but I heard he moved to Denmark. Yeah.
